value: Elsewhere on the isle, the Shattered Sun confronts Kael’thas within Magisters’ Terrace. His stand ends there; at the plateau, the Sunwell remains beneath his design. The prince is stopped, yet the fount itself is still in danger.
editorNote: The Terrace encounter and its quest order are secondary locators, while Blizzard supports the broad defeat of Kael’thas. Do not assert an exact date or that this dungeon is a universal raid prerequisite. Record remains research. Original-client and human source review are still required; no record is promoted to reviewed or published.
